text: やせいポケモンが　いる　ばしょで　つかうと　ポケモンが　でてくる。

structure.jp: やせいポケモンが　いる　ばしょで
structure.en: in a place where there are wild Pokémon

structure.jp: ポケモンが　でてくる。

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain action word means 'whenever this is done, that follows'. つかうと = 'if you use it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: やせいポケモンが　いる　ばしょ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in an action word placed right before a thing describes that thing. やせいポケモンが　いる　ばしょ = 'a place where there are wild Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form shows the action moving toward you. でてくる = 'comes out and appears'.
